title: Participle Clauses
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has aprendido a comprimir información compleja usando Cláusulas de Participio. Esto hará que tu inglés escrito y hablado sea mucho más fluido y profesional.

parts.visual:
Usamos cláusulas de participio (-ing o -ed) para unir dos frases que tienen el mismo sujeto. Hacen que el discurso sea más eficiente. 
Present Participle (-ing): para acciones activas o simultáneas. 
Ej: WALKING into the office, I saw the new CEO. (Al caminar hacia la oficina, vi al nuevo CEO).
parts.audio: We use participle clauses, ending in i n g or e d, to join two sentences that have the same subject. They make your speech more efficient. Present Participle for active or simultaneous actions. For example: Walking into the office, I saw the new CEO.

parts.visual:
Perfect Participle (Having + participio): Muestra que una acción terminó ANTES que la otra. 
Ej: HAVING SIGNED the contract, we celebrated. (Habiendo firmado / Después de firmar, celebramos). 
Past Participle (-ed): Para acciones pasivas. 
Ej: MANUFACTURED in China, the phone is very cheap. (Fabricado en China, el teléfono es muy barato).
parts.audio: Perfect Participle, using 'having' plus past participle. Shows that one action finished BEFORE the other. For example: Having signed the contract, we celebrated. Past Participle for passive actions. For example: Manufactured in China, the phone is very cheap.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la cláusula de participio correcta.

questions.question: ____ the email, I realized I had made a mistake. (Al leer / Leyendo).
____ the project early, the team received a bonus. (Habiendo terminado - acción previa).
questions.explanation: Perfect participle (Having + participio) porque terminar ocurrió ANTES de recibir el bono.

questions.question: ____ in 1998, Google is now a tech giant. (Fundada - voz pasiva).
questions.explanation: Past participle (Founded) porque la empresa fue fundaba por alguien más (pasiva).

questions.question: ____ to the manager, she explained the new strategy. (Hablando).
questions.explanation: Acción activa (-ing) realizada por el sujeto (ella).

questions.question: ____ the budget, we cannot hire new staff. (No habiendo aprobado / Como no hemos aprobado).
questions.explanation: Para la forma negativa, se pone 'Not' antes de 'having'.

questions.question: ____ about the delays, the client cancelled the order. (Estando enojado / Enojado - pasivo emocional).
questions.explanation: Adjetivo/participio pasado para describir un estado o emoción (pasiva).

questions.question: ____ hard all year, the employees expected a raise. (Habiendo trabajado).
questions.explanation: Having worked muestra que el trabajo (acción completada) llevó a la expectativa.

questions.question: ____ out of money, the startup had to close. (Habiéndose quedado sin dinero).
questions.explanation: Having run out of money (primero se quedaron sin dinero, luego cerraron).

questions.question: ____ by the CEO, the new rules are very strict. (Introducidas - pasiva).
questions.explanation: Past participle (Introduced) porque las reglas sufrieron la acción.

questions.question: ____ the room, he noticed everyone was quiet. (Entrando).
questions.explanation: Entering (acción simultánea, al entrar notó el silencio).

questions.question: ____ for three hours, the battery died. (Habiendo sido usada - pasiva perfecta).
questions.explanation: Having been + participio (acción pasiva que terminó antes).

questions.question: ____ tired, I decided to leave the office early. (Sintiéndome).
____ in Germany, the cars are known for their quality. (Fabricados).
____ the instructions, she didn't know what to do. (No entendiendo).
____ the report, he went home. (Después de enviar / Habiendo enviado).
questions.explanation: Primero envió, luego se fue. Having sent.

questions.question: ____ carefully, the plan should work perfectly. (Si es ejecutado / Ejecutado - pasivo).
questions.explanation: Executed (el plan es ejecutado, voz pasiva).

questions.question: ____ at the screen, she realized the system was hacked. (Mirando).
____ their final decision, the board left the room. (Habiendo tomado).
questions.explanation: Having made (primero tomaron la decisión, luego se fueron).

questions.question: ____ to London, the package will arrive tomorrow. (Enviado).
questions.explanation: Shipped (pasado participio, el paquete fue enviado).

questions.question: ____ the password, I couldn't log in. (Habiendo olvidado).
questions.explanation: Having forgotten (la acción de olvidar pasó primero).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el participio correcto (Presente: -ing, Pasado: -ed, Perfecto: Having + pp).

questions.question: ____ (work) on the project, I noticed a bug. (Trabajando)
____ (sign) the deal, we went to dinner. (Habiendo firmado)
____ (build) in 2020, the office is very modern. (Construida)
____ (read) the document, she disagreed. (Habiendo leído)
____ (feel) tired, I went home. (Sintiéndome)
____ (write) by the CEO, the email was serious. (Escrito)
____ (lose) my keys, I couldn't enter. (Habiendo perdido)
____ (arrive) at the hotel, I checked in. (Llegando)
____ (make) in Japan, it is highly reliable. (Hecho)
____ ____ (not / know) what to do, he called his boss. (No sabiendo)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la cláusula de participio correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Walking into the office, I saw the CEO.
options: Walking into the office, I saw the CEO.
Walked into the office, I saw the CEO.
Having walked into the office, I saw the CEO.
Walking to the office, I saw the CEO.
questions.correct_answer: Walking into the office, I saw the CEO.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Having signed the contract, we celebrated.
